title: On the Brittleness of Maximum Likelihood Estimation for Gaussian Process Hyperparameter Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2608.13793v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Machine learning (ML) has become an indispensable part of modern engineering design workflows. A crucial step in training an ML model is the selection of the loss function which can be systematically formulated via various techniques such as maximum likelihood estimation (MLE) and cross-validation . While MLE is one of the most popular, effective, and intuitive mechanisms for training ML models, it is brittle: if the assumptions underpinning it are not met, the trained ML model may generalize poorly. This brittleness affects even Gaussian processes (GPs) which are widely used in engineering design and are often (incorrectly) presumed to be very robust to overfitting. In this paper, we fundamentally evaluate the brittleness of MLE in the context of training GPs for probabilistic regression or classification tasks. translated_title: 高斯过程超参数优化中最大似然估计的脆弱性研究
translated_abstract: 机器学习（ML）已成为现代工程设计工作流程中不可或缺的一部分。训练ML模型的关键步骤之一是选择损失函数，这可以通过最大似然估计（MLE）和交叉验证等多种技术系统化地制定。尽管MLE是训练ML模型最流行、有效且直观的机制之一，但它具有脆弱性：如果支撑其的假设不成立，训练出的ML模型可能泛化能力较差。这种脆弱性甚至影响到高斯过程（GPs），而GPs在工程设计中广泛使用，且常被（错误地）认为对过拟合非常稳健。在本文中，我们从根本上评估了MLE在训练GPs用于概率回归或分类任务时的脆弱性。我们将理论上有依据的指标与MLE进行比较，并提出实用解决方案。我们的广泛研究表明...
tldr: 本文揭示了最大似然估计在高斯过程超参数优化中的脆弱性，并提出基于理论指标的实用替代方案，以提高模型泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals the brittleness of maximum likelihood estimation in Gaussian process hyperparameter optimization and proposes practical alternatives based on theoretically grounded metrics to improve model generalization.
